songs.name: It's All Over Now Baby Blue

ai_show_review.summary: High‑energy Samson & Delilah, standout Far From Me and tight second set
ai_show_review.blurb: The Boston Garden show bursts with high energy, highlighted by a soaring Samson & Delilah and a fiery Far From Me. The first‑set opener Jack Straw > Sugaree rolls smoothly into a solid mid‑set, while the second set builds to an emotive All Over Now Baby Blue encore. Soundboard recordings capture crisp guitars and punchy drums, making this a fan‑favorite performance.
ai_show_review.review: What unfolds at the Boston Garden on September 18, 1982 is a quintessential early‑'80s Dead night – birthday‑shout‑outs for Brent, smoking Jerry tones, and a rhythm section that never loses its groove. The first set kicks off with a punchy Jack Straw > Sugaree segue, moves through a rollicking West L.A. Fadeaway and lands on the heartfelt Far From Me, where Brent’s piano adds just the right splash of color. The second set is the real high‑water mark: Samson & Delilah erupts into a blazing showcase of Jerry’s lead work and Phil’s “bomb justice” bass, segueing into Uncle John's Band > Playing In The Band before the classic Drum‑Space‑Throwing Stones sequence. Throwing Stones, The Wheel, Truckin' (despite a few flubs) and Wharf Rat keep the momentum rolling, culminating in an earnest All Over Now Baby Blue that lets Jerry’s voice shine one last time. Across all available recordings – especially the recommended Weise soundboard – the mix is crisp enough to hear every nuance while still delivering the raw excitement of a live Garden crowd.

best_recording.reason: Crisp soundboard capture with balanced mix, clear Jerry tones and strong percussion, making the performance most listenable.

key_highlights: Scorching Samson & Delilah that showcases Jerry’s lead work and Phil’s powerful bass.
Heart‑warming Far From Me featuring Brent’s piano flair and a birthday shout‑out vibe.
Tight Jack Straw > Sugaree opener that sets an energetic tone for the night.
Emotive All Over Now Baby Blue encore delivering one of Jerry’s best vocal moments.
song_highlights: It's All Over Now Baby Blue

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers smoking lead tones throughout, especially on Samson & Delilah and the encore; his voice shines on Baby Blue.
band_performance.Phil: Provides steady, sometimes ‘bomb justice’ bass foundation; a few mixes note thinness but performance remains solid.
band_performance.Bob: Adds high‑octane rhythm guitar and memorable banter, driving the energy on Samson & Delilah.
band_performance.Brent: Gets birthday shout‑outs, struts on Far From Me, and adds tasteful piano texture to Uncle John's Band.
band_performance.Mickey: Locks in with Bill for a solid percussive backbone that underpins the high‑energy jams.
band_performance.Billy: Highlights include a memorable drum solo and overall excitement that pushes the set forward.
